name: Apprenticeship Application (Employer Notification)
description: Sent to the employer's apprenticeship contact when a university student applies for one of their apprenticeship programmes
subject: New apprenticeship application — {programme_title} ({student_name})
body_html:
New Apprenticeship Application

Dear {contact_name},

{student_name} has applied for an apprenticeship with {employer_name} through {institution_name}.

Reference{application_reference}
Applicant{student_name} ({student_id})
Email{student_email}
Programme{programme_title}
Standard{programme_reference} (Level {programme_level})
Duration{duration_months} months
Applied on{applied_on}
Status{status}

Applicant's notes:
{notes}

Please review the application and respond through the apprenticeships system. If you are not the right person for apprenticeship recruitment at {employer_name}, let us know and we will update our records.

{signature}

contact_name.description: Name of the employer contact receiving the application

programme_title.description: Title of the apprenticeship standard applied for

separator.description: Visual separator for the text version

signature.description: Email signature; supplied by the renderer when omitted
